FINISH & DEPTH : ZINK BLACK PASSIVATION TRIVALENT TEST COUPON SIZE :(⌀25 x 50mm LENGTH - 02NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"Note N15 specifies the heat treatment (TOUGHENED, 24–32 HRC) and the surface finish (IZBP) but does not state the manufacturing stage at which each applies. Without sequencing, the shop may apply plating before or after toughening, risking a ruined coating or incorrect hardness. The designer should add explicit stage callouts, for example 'Toughen before final machining; apply IZBP after all machining is complete.'","recommended_correction":"Add the process sequence to note N15 so that heat treatment and plating stages are unambiguous."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D20","page":2,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N16","page":1,"quote":"FINISH : IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D20 calls out an ⌀8 H7 hole on a part whose finish is IZBP (zinc black passivation per note N16), yet no allowance is made for the plating thickness on this tight ISO fit. Plating buildup will shrink the bore below the H7 limit, preventing assembly of the mating pin. The designer should either specify a pre-plate undersize for the hole or add a note requiring reaming/masking after plating.","recommended_correction":"Provide a pre-plating tolerance or a post-plating rework instruction for the ⌀8 H7 hole shown in D20."}]}
